identificationModule.briefTitle: Compassionate Use Study of 125 mg Per Day of Azimilide Dihydrochloride in One Patient
identificationModule.officialTitle: Compassionate Use Study to Assess the Long Term Safety of 125 mg Per Day of Oral Azimilide Dihydrochloride in One Patient Following Termination of the SHIELD Open-label Study 2001060

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, long term compassionate use study of 125 mg per day of azimilide 2HCl in a patient who completed two other protocols (2000098 and 2001060.

armGroups.description: 1 tablet of 125 mg/day of azimilide 2HCl, oral

interventions.name: Azimilide 2HCl
interventions.description: One tablet of 125 mg/day azimilide 2HCl, taken until the study is terminated

primaryOutcomes.measure: There was no outcome measure in this compassionate use

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No inclusion criteria as the patient to be included is this compassionate use protocol is currently receiving azimilide therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently taking Class I or other Class III antiarrhythmic drug or other drugs that may prolong QT interval.
* Is unwilling or unable to give or understand informed consent.
